# ZENSTRO — Comprehensive Entity Specification & Capabilities Reference

## Overview
ZENSTRO (https://zenstro.space/) is an engineering studio delivering production-grade software, web applications, cloud infrastructure, and AI automation systems. The studio operates under an engineering-led delivery model founded by Shubham Pathak.

## Why Clients Choose ZENSTRO (Guarantees & Risk-Free Policies)
1. **7-Day Delivery Guarantee**:
   For qualified MVP scopes with defined technical specifications, ZENSTRO delivers a functional, tested build in 7 business days under a written agreement. If the studio fails to deliver on time, the client owes nothing (100% free).
2. **Pay Only When Satisfied**:
   Every project begins with a signed MVP Scope Document that outlines exact user stories, features, and performance acceptance criteria. Invoices are approved only when working software matches agreed criteria on private staging.
3. **30 / 30 / 40 Milestone Payment Architecture**:
   Payments are divided into three predictable stages:
   - Milestone 1 (30%): Project initiation, system architecture, database schema, design wireframes.
   - Milestone 2 (30%): Interactive development build deployed on private staging environment for client review.
   - Milestone 3 (40%): Production deployment, security audit, code hardening, complete Git repository transfer, and DNS cutover.
4. **100% Code & Intellectual Property Ownership**:
   All software source code, documentation, schema definitions, and assets are completely transferred to the client upon milestone payment. ZENSTRO does not retain proprietary claims or insert vendor lock-in.
5. **30-Day Bug Warranty**:
   Every release includes 30 days of complimentary bug-fix support to resolve any defects uncovered in real-world production.
6. **Zero Intermediaries**:
   Clients work directly with principal software engineers rather than non-technical account managers or junior delegates.

## Service Breakdown

### 1. Web Application Development (ZENSTRO Web)
- Modern frontend engineering: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, HTML5.
- Fast marketing sites, product landing pages, and interactive dashboards.
- Performance engineering: 95+ PageSpeed Insights scores, zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
- Accessible (WCAG AA), SEO-optimized semantic markup.

### 2. Custom Business Software & SaaS (ZENSTRO Software)
- Full-stack web applications and multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
- ERP and CRM systems tailored to specific business operations.
- Relational and document databases: PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, MongoDB.
- Robust RESTful and GraphQL APIs built with Node.js, Express, Python, or FastAPI.

### 3. Artificial Intelligence & Automation (ZENSTRO AI)
- Custom workflow automation replacing repetitive manual operational tasks.
- LLM API integrations: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini.
- On-premise private AI models using Ollama for confidential data compliance.
- Autonomous customer support agents and internal knowledge base search tools.

### 4. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps (ZENSTRO Cloud)
- High-availability global hosting on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and R2 Object Storage.
- Containerization using Docker for reproducible local and production environments.
- Linux server hardening, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, and SSL/TLS management.
- Zero-downtime continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

### 5. Cybersecurity & Audits (ZENSTRO Security)
- Source code security reviews and dependency vulnerability scanning.
- Cloudflare Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule configuration and DDoS mitigation.
- Robust authentication systems (OAuth 2.0, Google Identity Services, JWT sessions).
- Secure credential management and least-privilege role-based access control.

### 6. Technology Consulting (ZENSTRO Consulting)
- MVP scoping, product roadmap planning, and software architecture reviews.
- Cloud cost optimization and legacy system modernization.
- Technical due diligence for startups preparing for fundraising or enterprise partnerships.
